name: lpludo
description: 1v1 Ludo battle platform — MERN + Tailwind + Redis rebuild of the reference app (local-first)

scripts.infra:up: mkdir -p .data/mongo .data/redis && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait && npm run db:init
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f mongo redis
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && rm -rf .data && npm run infra:up
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lpludo/shared && npm run test -w @lpludo/api
